metadata.name: Character Enhance
metadata.description:
[h1]Character Enhance[/h1] Independently configurable enhancements for Eve, Eden, Tainted Lost, Tainted Blue Baby, Tainted Eden, Bethany, and Esau Jr. Eve keeps a 1.00x damage multiplier with or without Whore of Babylon. Eden can replace the native starting passive and each Eden's Blessing reward with a choice of three from all eligible collectibles, including active items. Also includes C Section Incubus animation, native Zodiac floor effects with inert gray item-tracker icons and My Stuff descriptions, pill-identification fixes for room rewinds and rerolled PHD items, absorbed-stat reroll preservation, small-player pickup-range, familiar-limit, pickup-animation, Kid's Drawing form-count, Ocular Rift sound, Lost Soul white-fire protection with an optional Holy Mantle grant, and The Clog creep-damage fixes. Requires Repentance+ 1.9.7.15; this is the only tested game version. Other versions are unverified. REPENTOGON is not required.
[h1]角色增强[/h1] 为夏娃、伊甸、里游魂、里蓝人、里伊甸、伯大尼和小以扫提供可独立开关的增强功能。夏娃无论是否激活巴比伦大淫妇都保持100%攻击倍率。伊甸可以把原生初始被动和每份伊甸的祝福奖励分别改为三选一，候选覆盖包括主动道具在内的全部合格收藏品。另包含剖腹产下的淫魔动画、由原版黄道十二宫提供的层效果、无属性灰色道具栏图标及 My Stuff 说明、房间回溯与 Roll 后 PHD 的药丸识别修复、Roll 全身道具后吸收属性保留、小体型拾取范围、跟班上限、拾取动画、儿童涂鸦套装计数、邪眼裂口异常音效、可选给予神圣屏障的迷失幽魂白火免伤，以及拦路屎水迹伤害修复。需要《忏悔+》1.9.7.15，且仅测试该游戏版本；其他版本尚未验证。不需要 REPENTOGON。
Supports English and Simplified Chinese Mod Config Menu labels. / 支持英文与简体中文 Mod Config Menu。
